items.title: Wayne Bergeron interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 29, 2020
items.q: Wayne was interviewed via Zoom on December 29, 2020 by Monk Rowe

ctx.x: Well congratulations on that and for your whole career, and this has been marvelous.

Yeah, thank you, Monk, this is a great interview and I’m glad this wasn’t — I like doing these things that are not so preconceived and we could just talk about some stuff and they just flow better I think.
